widgets.html:
DIK🧀 LUA RUNTIME

Script quick reference

Scripts implement function on_event(event), receive a copied event, and return a status plus typed actions.

Core globals

assert error ipairs next pairs pcall select tonumber tostring type xpcall

Libraries

math · string · table · bit32

Removed: string.format, string.gsub, string.rep, table.concat, table.move, and table.unpack.

Context

context.scriptId · context.state · context.widgets · context.androidAccess

context.accessibility exists only for an accessibility-window event snapshot.

Not available

debug io os package require load dofile loadfile print

Lua has no Android object handles or arbitrary shell access.

Return actions

accessibilityAction · accessibilityGesture · accessibilityGlobalAction · selectPage · patchWidget · patchState · patchDom · launchApp · appAction · postNotification · sendSms · explicitIntent · emitEvent · mediaControl · mediaVolume · notificationControl · lockDevice
Use the Script dashboard for source, status, enablement, and logs. Full event and action contracts: Automation control docs.

scripts.source:
function on_event(event)
  local unread = {}
  local notificationKey = event.payload.notificationKey
  for _, item in pairs(context.state.unread or {}) do
    if item.key ~= notificationKey then
      unread[#unread + 1] = item
    end
  end
  if event.type == "notificationPosted" then
    unread[#unread + 1] = {
      key = notificationKey,
      title = event.payload.title or "Notification",
      text = event.payload.text or ""
    }
  end
  local body = ""
  for _, item in pairs(unread) do
    local line = item.title
    if item.text ~= "" then
      line = line .. ": " .. item.text
    end
    if body == "" then
      body = line
    else
      body = body .. "\n" .. line
    end
  end
  if body == "" then
    body = "No active notifications."
  end
  return {
    status = tostring(#unread) .. " active notification(s)",
    actions = {
      { type = "patchState", values = { unread = unread } },
      { type = "patchWidget", widgetAddress = "1H1V-command-deck", values = { state = { body = body, notificationCount = #unread } } },
      { type = "emitEvent", event = "notification.digest.updated", payload = { count = #unread } }
    }
  }
end
